note: Synthetic, builder-written inputs. Final-source reruns are regression checks; historical gates retain their dates. No real-user outcome validation.

checks.name: Suggestion accuracy
checks.what: Correct activity suggested on each of two previously used description sets (final-source regression)

checks.name: Model against keyword search
checks.what: Relevant roles in the top five per 50, model with your ticks against keyword (BM25) suggestions

checks.name: Complete chain
checks.what: Relevant roles in the top five per 50, from fresh text to roles

checks.name: Routes for in-scope people
checks.what: Newest predeclared set 8: final-source rerun of profiles with two relevant routes and a four-week block serving three gaps; first run also 7/12, below 80%
checks.second_what: out-of-scope controls pass; same-input title-only 0/12 and keyword 2/12

checks.name: No dead end
checks.what: Out-of-scope test profiles shown roles to explore instead of routes

checks.name: Guard
checks.what: Newest test set, written before its first run: sentences about free time, attempts that did not work out and plans held back

checks.name: Names, gender and age
checks.what: Work sentences giving identical suggestions in every name, gender and age variant

checks.name: AI-shift backtest
checks.what: Average error predicting the June 2026 value of 500 activities, in points: historical average against the last value

checks.name: Forecast signals
checks.what: Skill-demand values recomputed separately from the raw files without a mismatch

checks.name: Every number has a source
checks.what: Radar and Future figures citing a dated source, for two example people and the explore view under four settings
checks.second_what: screens in the browser at 390 and 1280 px, light and dark, without an unsourced number

checks.name: Requirement labels
checks.what: Roles whose labels agree with the raw O*NET Job Zone and experience files

checks.name: Evidence-to-plan replay
checks.what: Dedicated fixed-profile replay checks, including a checkpoint change; the current moderate-scenario Hafiz example has no changed steps

checks.name: Held-out casual descriptions
checks.what: Sentences with a correct activity in the top five, fine-tuned model (shipped only because it beat the previous model and an export control, both fixed before training)

checks.name: Long sentences
checks.what: Labelled activities suggested after reading long sentences in parts (development result; before 11/31)

checks.name: Negation scope
checks.what: Own-work controls kept on the final development run; negations held 8/8
